text: Cycling is a sport that demands precision and control. The most common component of a cycling bike is the front and rear brake system. The brake pads are placed in the brake caliper, which is a small device that holds the brake pads to the caliper. The brake pads are then pushed against the rim of the tire, applying a large amount of force to stop the bike. The pedals are also connected to the brake system, allowing for easy and efficient pedaling.
